name: Things with motors
thesis: An independent maker zine with colliding type, a coral personal note, and a huge real printer as the cover subject.
interaction: A tilted pull-tab removes SERV0’s panels with an aligned image crossfade; the cover machine settles into place on arrival.
why: The personality comes from Raygen’s own machines, illustrated avatar, and affection for making, with the pace and composition of a small-run creative publication.
